_meta.purpose: D-140 phase 3: an infant food's own checks from FSSAI's rules for foods for infant nutrition (lenses/infant.py). Computed and stored for reviewers (D-140); shown to users too with INSIDELABEL_INFANT_TO_USERS on (D-200, the default), else in shadow: users see the allergen lines, the kind and the ingredient list.

source.title: FSS (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020, compendium Version II (04.01.2024)
source.status: in force from 1 October 2022 (FSSAI order 29.03.2022, direction 18.10.2022; docs/BABY_FOOD.md section 0)
source.pages: PDF page numbers; every row read from the page image by Claude on 2026-09-30 (D-046)

rules: Phrases are matched as whole words on the text lower-cased, apostrophes removed, anything else not a letter or digit a space (core/pack_kind.norm).
A statement is 'not found' only when both faces were read whole (lenses/nutra.complete_read); otherwise nothing is said.
The product type comes from the product's printed name and the front's own words, never from regulation 4's statements: those name 'infant milk substitute or infant food' whatever the type.

phrases: food for infants based on traditional food ingredients

types.basis: 2(1)(h), PDF p. 2; 7, PDF p. 7 (Chapter 2 'Infant Milk Substitute'); 7(3), PDF p. 12 ('Infant Milk Food')

statements.text: the words "IMPORTANT NOTICE" in capital letters
"MOTHER'S MILK IS BEST FOR YOUR BABY" in capital letters, on the front of the pack
match: mothers milk is best for your baby

statements.text: "Infant food shall be introduced only after the age of six months and up to the age of two years"
match: introduced only after the age of six months
introduced only after the age of 6 months
statements.fssai_basis: 4(1)(a), PDF p. 4 ('In case of infant food')

statements.text: a statement that infant milk substitute or infant food shall be used only on the advice of a health worker as to the need for its use and the proper method of its use
a warning that Infant milk substitute or infant food is not the sole source of nourishment of an infant
match: not the sole source of nourishment

statements.text: "Warning/Caution-Careful and hygienic preparation of infant foods or infant milk substitute is most essential for health."
"Store in a cool and dry place in an air tight container" or the like
"Warning: Boiled and cooled water shall be used to prepare this product and any leftover product must be discarded to reduce the risk of infection"

no_milk.text: "Contains no milk or milk products or milk derivatives", on a product which contains neither milk nor any milk derivatives
no_milk.when: Only when the allergen check (lenses/allergens.py) says milk is not listed on a complete, confident read; contains, may contain or uncertain say nothing.

words_not_to_use.text: The terms "Humanised" or "Maternalised" or any other similar words shall not be used. The package and/or any other label of infant milk substitute or infant food shall not exhibit the words, "Full Protein Food", "Energy Food", "Completer Food" or "Health Food" or any other similar expression.
words_not_to_use.note: The regulation's words and their -ized spelling only; 'any other similar words' and 'similar expression' are judgements, not made (docs/BABY_FOOD.md 4.2). A picture of an infant or a woman is a reviewer check, never the app's.

free_from.text: Food for infant nutrition shall be free from preservatives, added colours and flavours.
free_from.note: Additive classes from data/additives.json by INS (core/tokenize.ins_numbers); a flavour enhancer is its own class, not a flavour.

no_hydrogenated.names_from: data/ingredient_notes.json row hydrogenated_fat (names and exclude, D-132/D-135)

rows.text: Hydrogenated vegetable oils and fats shall not be used in infant formula.
It shall not contain hydrogenated vegetable fats and oils.
It shall not contain hydrogenated vegetable oils and fats.
Partially hydrogenated oils and fats shall not be used in follow-up formula.

no_hydrogenated.note: Traditional foods (11) have no such sentence: nothing is said for them.

reviewer_checks.text: No picture of an infant or a woman or both, and no picture or other graphic material or phrase designed to increase the saleability
